description: US federal job openings from the official USAJOBS Search API: title, agency, location, pay range, closing date, link. Needs a free USAJOBS key (set USAJOBS_API_KEY and USAJOBS_EMAIL); without them the tool answers 503. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: jobs_usajobs
title: Jobs Usajobs
